title: Flux requests get more reliable defaults
summary:
A reliability day: steadier Flux generation, an auto-deployed model health monitor, and refreshed integration plumbing.

The io.net Flux path now includes its required x-enter-token header, while Flux generation consistently runs at the maximum four-step setting. Fewer configuration-shaped surprises between a prompt and its pixels.

A model health-status view landed in the Pollinations app, and the model monitor was added to apps.json for automatic deployment. The infrastructure now has a more direct way to report whether it is having a normal day.

The G4F integration received an update, and bot authentication moved from the POLLI_PAT token to the POLLY_BOT app token.

highlights.title: Video Generation
highlights.text: Create videos from text or images using **Veo** and **Seedance** models via API or [Chat](https://hello.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Seedream 4.5
highlights.text: Upgraded image generation to **Seedream 4.5** supporting stunning 2K resolution.

highlights.title: Web Search
highlights.text: **Perplexity** and **Gemini** models can now access real-time web search results.

highlights.title: Amazon Nova Micro
highlights.text: Added `nova-micro` to text services for ultra-low-cost, high-speed inference.

highlights.title: High-Res Upgrades
highlights.text: `seedream` updated to v4.5 (2K resolution) and `seedance` upgraded to Pro-Fast for superior quality.

highlights.title: Richer Chat
highlights.text: The [Chat UI](https://chat.pollinations.ai) now renders data charts and supports video generation directly.
